title: Unemployment Benefit Claims Review Days after a Recent Payment Method Change
content:
Review days are business days added to the election lead time of a payment election on an Unemployment Benefit Claims record when the payment method on the claim took effect recently. The date read is the payment method effective date on the claim, counted in calendar days to the handling date.

| Payment method effective date on the claim | Review days |
|---|---|
| No more than 30 days before the handling date | 3 |
| More than 30 days but no more than 90 days before the handling date | 1 |
| More than 90 days before the handling date | None |

## Boundary days

| Days from the payment method effective date to the handling date | Review days |
|---|---|
| 30 | 3 |
| 31 | 1 |
| 90 | 1 |
| 91 | None |

A claim whose current method took effect at filing, more than 90 days before the handling date, carries no review days.
